comment: Recognition layer 2: community/district signs along the Airport→Ochi route. Coordinates are real lat/lon projected via road.project(). Radius is trigger distance in compressed-world metres. Entries marked needs_owner_review are sourced from OSM/research — the owner's lived knowledge is authoritative for placement and naming.

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: Gateway from the Palisadoes strip into Kingston — the big roundabout

communities.name: Rockfort
communities.note: Home of the Rockfort Mineral Baths; industrial eastern Kingston

communities.name: East Kingston
communities.note: Working-class community along Windward Road into the city

communities.name: Cross Roads
communities.note: Major city junction — the gateway between downtown and uptown Kingston

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: The commercial heart of uptown Kingston — the 1813 clock tower marks the centre

communities.name: Spanish Town
communities.note: Jamaica's former colonial capital — the historic square is at the centre

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: Entrance to the dramatic gorge — Flat Bridge and the Rio Cobre are ahead

communities.name: Ewarton
communities.note: Industrial community in the gorge area, known for the bauxite plant

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: Famous for its bustling market and the Jamaican folk song 'Linstead Market'

communities.name: Guy's Hill
communities.note: Rural community in the hills between Linstead and Moneague

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: Crossroads junction town in the hills of St. Ann

communities.name: Faith's Pen
communities.note: Legendary string of roadside cookshops — jerk chicken, roast yam, festival

communities.name: Milford
communities.note: Village at the crest of Fern Gully — the famous canopy begins here

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: Tourist hub of the north coast — Dunn's River Falls is the journey's end
